note: Which skills fill each role the loop needs, per asset set. The loop calls skills by role, not by name, because the two sets do not share names: skills were renamed, merged and split as they took on campaign-specific content. Hardcoding a name made the runner work for exactly one set — loop/skill_runner.py named two initial-set skills and so could not run against the final set at all. Every entry here must be consistent with evolution/ASSET_RENAMES.json, which scripts/qa/test_asset_roles.py enforces.

roles.guess_generation: Produce transition-state guesses for one elementary step, given reactant, product and the reaction kind.
roles.failure_diagnosis: Read a failed attempt and decide what to try next, or that the step should be abandoned.

exclusions..skills/generate-ts-guesses -> .skills/p: ASSET_RENAMES records generate-ts-guesses as merging into both ts-validation-strategy and pathway-method. Only the first fills the guess_generation role: pathway-method is the route-level operating recipe and is authoritative about the bar and packaging, so loading it into a single-step guess call would supply route-level instruction where a step-level decision is being made. The exclusion is declared here rather than left implicit, because silently dropping half of a recorded merge is how an asset set stops matching its own history.
